engineering_notes: This is a refinement of the existing Lab, not a new product architecture. Preserve destinations, permissions, queries, ranking, money semantics, independent service states and mutation behavior. Public demonstrations reuse those components and fixture adapters; they do not introduce a parallel product.

Build order: shared tokens and the source-to-decision joint; Public static compositions; Business Home; Profile and User Home; Public scroll enhancement and interactive business demonstration; browser review. Business Content receives only the consistency changes listed below.

Use CSS Grid, native overflow, position:sticky, IntersectionObserver and one requestAnimationFrame-throttled scroll listener. Update CSS custom properties, not React state per frame. No animation framework or continuous WebGL background.

All three public chapters must have their own complete media and product composition in the DOM. Do not reuse one absolutely positioned illustration across three otherwise empty sections. Only the visible chapter may have an active player or canvas.

Extract or reuse SourceFigure, RecreateCommitment, StoryEligibility, CampaignWorkSummary, PersonSpread, VehiclePreview and the existing Content inspector. Public excerpts are real HTML using the same formatters, state labels and permitted actions as the app, not independently redrawn marketing UI.

Keep public demonstration mutations in an isolated demo-store namespace. Label the demonstration before any amount or action. Selecting a person or scrolling must never submit a request, approve content, accept work or create earnings.

Retain the supplied fictional records and explicitly freeze the Lab adapter clock to May 14, 2026. Production uses its actual clock and backend statuses. Do not silently extend these example campaign deadlines.
Load Archivo and IBM Plex Sans through the existing font pipeline. Use rem equivalents, tabular monetary numerals and metric-adjusted fallbacks. No third font.

No new generated imagery is required. The existing photographs provide a coherent world; spend this pass on their scale, framing and relationship to working UI. Existing generated illustrations remain visibly identified as demonstrations, never real customer evidence.

Default fixtures contain neither playable reference footage nor vehicle reconstructions. Ship the finished still-image treatment now. Do not add play controls, durations, fake orbit states or substitute models to make the screenshots appear more advanced.

Retain initial phone transfer target of 600KB or less before optional media, LCP target of 2.5s, CLS below 0.1 and INP below 200ms. These are test targets, not claimed measurements. Preload only the actual LCP image; defer videos and three.js.

Review actual 1440×900 and 390×844 captures, plus 320×568, 1024px, enlarged text, keyboard focus and reduced motion. Capture each public chapter at its beginning and settled position, a continuous scroll recording, both business-demo modes, the scrolled car shelf and mutation failures. Do not award final scores from a full-page contact sheet alone.

screens.what_makes_it_only_tapmart: A photographic source physically hands off to a fixed, working commitment edge: reference to filming to conditional video pay; intact supplied artwork to Instagram eligibility to a work state; a vehicle to a separate placement concept to monthly campaign terms. The three changes of material are one continuous demonstration, not three marketing illustrations.
acceptance: At 1440×900, the first fold contains the entire three-line headline, literal task explanation, equal audience actions, a large filming photograph, one upright implemented phone and the beginning of the graphite Recreate chapter.

The hero photograph is 624×416px, not the current 510×340px. Its meaningful filming action remains unobscured by the phone. The enlarged HTML payment excerpt is labeled Demo opportunity before its amount.

Every earning chapter contains all three explanatory objects in its default screenshot. Post and Drive cannot become empty regions in a full-page capture because another chapter owns the only media stage.

At a pinned chapter capture, the source assembly occupies 872px and its real product commitment occupies 448px, with a 24px junction. No oversized heading is used as a substitute for missing product demonstration.
Recreate shows a still reference, a filming illustration and the $65.00 per-approved-video UI. There is no fabricated video playback.
Post shows the unmodified Story, the explicitly manual Instagram state and the returned eligibility result, then the real open or applied work state. Scrolling never accepts the application.
Drive shows campaign-car-context-01, a separately labeled placement concept and the $240.00 per-month campaign. It does not imply that Maya's owned car has been booked or that an ad is installed.

The business section is one working demonstration with selectable Campaigns and Monthly content views. View person opens a named recipient; a demo approval changes only file approval, leaving publication separate.
On phone, every chapter is a complete vertical explanation with native-size HTML facts. There are no pinned regions, horizontal chapter carousels or miniature desktop inspectors.
The Get paid region distinguishes conditional work, available earnings and a requested payout. All values remain still. No requested payout is presented as paid.
Reduced motion and missing optional media produce finished compositions, not blank stages or instructions to enable animation.
choreography: Desktop enhancement applies only at widths of at least 1200px and viewport heights of at least 800px. At 1440×900, each earning section is 900px high and contains its own 780px sticky panel, top:80px. The pin lasts 120px of native scrolling. Sections touch; there is no additional inter-chapter spacer.

For each chapter, let S be its document top. Progress p runs from 0 at scrollY=S−320 to 1 at scrollY=S+40, clamped across 360px. The first 240px occur during approach; the final 120px occur while pinned. The composition is complete before enhancement, and progress changes emphasis and source geometry only.

Recreate, p=0–0.4: the reference image scales from 224×398px to 176×313px around its top-left origin. Its native-size caption follows the image bottom. The filming photograph moves from x=248,y=32 to x=200,y=0 within the 872px source field. Both originals remain fully visible.

Recreate, p=0.4–0.8: the 24px structural joint behind the fixed work panel resolves from an exposed graphite edge to the cobalt payment edge. This is a background treatment, not a loading bar. From p=0.8–1, the assembly rests. The amount, conditions and action never translate or change state.

Post, p=0–0.4: the intact 288×512px Story moves horizontally from x=112 to x=32 within the source field. The eligibility block remains at x=448. From p=0.4–0.75, its white backing settles by 24px behind stationary text. From p=0.75–1, the fixed work panel remains the destination of the composition; no application or publication state advances.

Drive, p=0–0.45: the 640×427px vehicle photograph moves vertically from y=24 to y=0. From p=0.45–0.75, the separate placement diagram moves 24px into its reserved 208px field. From p=0.75–1, the monthly work panel rests. Artwork never moves onto the photographed vehicle.

No chapter exit fades its content away. The next chapter enters naturally as the previous local sticky panel releases. Background changes happen at these real section boundaries: graphite for making, mineral canvas for supplied creative, underlay for physical inventory.

The business demonstration is not scroll-controlled. Its two explicit mode buttons replace the selected workspace over 180ms, preserving selection within each mode. A focused or edited form cannot be replaced by scroll position.

Below the enhancement breakpoint, with reduced motion, or without JavaScript, use ordinary content-height sections containing the settled compositions. No pinning, translation, source scaling or reserved scroll runway.

founder_read: Frame Shift's product logic is approved; its recognizability is not. I will keep the destinations, work types, money meanings, content service, real statuses and progressive disclosure. I will change the scale and relationship of sources, turn the offset mark into a repeatable product joint, replace the public page's sparse explanations with complete working demonstrations, make business discovery desirable rather than record-like, and give identity and the small vehicle capability a stronger presence. I will not buy distinctiveness with more copy, fake activity, invented proof, arbitrary new colors or a car-showroom interface.

self_critique: My previous high scores rewarded fidelity to Frame Shift more than final ownability. These specifications are a stronger direction, not proof that recognition, premium feel and usability now score nine. The next judgment must use real stills and interaction recordings.

The offset joint could become another decorative motif. I limited it to source-to-decision relationships and one identity boundary; it must not appear on ordinary settings rows, every heading or every button.

Horizontal people browsing could hide inventory. The full People view remains, controls are visible, order is unchanged and the first three spreads exactly fill the desktop field. If native scrolling or keyboard discovery is weak, fix that before adding animation.

The public choreography could still feel like a presentation trick. Every chapter therefore begins complete, remains complete at rest and contains real product UI. Scroll changes composition, never acceptance, approval or money.

There is no real video or vehicle model in these fixtures. Rather than promise a cinematic state the engineer cannot honestly build, the baseline depends on strong existing photographs and working HTML. Optional media is genuinely optional.

The warmer neutral could drift into a generic editorial marketplace. Cobalt and graphite stay unchanged, copy stays operational, and recognition must come from the three distinct work compositions and fixed commitment edge.

what_it_is_not: Not a logo pasted onto generic cards or corner brackets decorating every section.
Not an Instagram or TikTok feed: no popularity hierarchy, endless autoplay, reactions or swipe-to-next work.
Not a car app: no dominant vehicle hero in Profile, default model, configurator or fake scan.
Not a directory: people are encountered through specific work and a named request, not a stack of identity metadata.
Not AI spectacle: no neon, blobs, decorative 3D, invented proof, fake installed ads or progress theatre.
Not motion-dependent: a paused or reduced-motion screenshot must still show source, conditions and next action.
signature.idea: Frame Shift becomes a source-to-commitment joint. A real source begins on one plane; the useful decision starts 12px later on phone or 24px later on desktop, leaving the open corner already present in the TapMart mark. The source may change scale or move into inspection, but the commitment stays still. Recreate joins a reference to graphite and cobalt conditional pay, Story treats supplied creative as an intact sheet beside eligibility and ink terms, and Car ends a physical scene in a monthly caption.
